race.comment: STRIPES (7) made it two wins on the trot last start when she won a much easier race than this over 2138m at this track, getting home by 11 metres. Will be sent out as the hot favourite and looks hard to beat again. RUBY RHAYNE BOW (2) is looking for Group One success after taking out a much weaker race at her latest appearance over 2138m at this track, scoring by 1.75 metres. Should enjoy a lovely run and looks a genuine contender again. AMYLEE (11) found one better last start over 2138m at this track, beaten 1.75 metres. Sure to prove hard to beat again. MISS BLUETRUMP (1) comes here fresh from a second eight days ago over 2138m at this track, beaten 1.4 metres. Drawn well so she is a great chance to take this out.
